excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
excerpt.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.
